# Discovery of the G502 X PLUS through the LIGHTSPEED receiver (USB 046D:C547),
# 2026-11-20. RX and RXS lines were captured by `palaswitch-cli sniff`, which
# only sees incoming reports (RX = long collection, RXS = short collection);
# the TX lines are the requests `palaswitch-cli list` sent at the same time,
# in the order the responses show. The mouse had been idle for a while, so
# the ping at index 1 took about 0.6 s.
# index 0xFF is the receiver itself: HID++ 1.0 error 0x01 (invalid sub ID)

RXS 10 FF 8F 00 1E 01 00
